title: URGENT: The $2.4 Trillion AI Infrastructure Reset
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: Brian hosts Professor G (Nolan) for a community-Q&A episode (Brian's channel) on portfolio construction and 2026 picks. First half is allocation philosophy: Nolan argues for a risk-tiered funnel (~60% broad growth like QQQM, ~30% sector ETF like SMH/VGT, ~10% individual stocks, with ~20% in a value anchor like SCHD/VTV); Brian is stock-heavy himself (mega-cap core, tiny speculative slivers) but agrees ETFs suit most people, and both stress time-in-market over timing and rebalancing only in retirement accounts. On add/trim rules, Brian trims only when one holding dominates (Nvidia) or after 100-200% pops in speculative names (takes principal off), and cut dead money like Plug Power. The stock picks: Nolan's 2026 list (host-only) is Redcat (RCAT; his call was ~$7, now $17-18; add on pullback to $10-12), IREN (in the 50s; big firms calling 80s-90s), APLD, plus SCHD/VTV as the value-cycle ETF trade. Brian counters with Modine (data-center cooling, beaten down after heavy production investment, tiny speculative position) and ARKQ (robotics ETF), and likes AeroVironment as a drone complement to RCAT after its pullback. Brian's own line on RCAT: 'I have RCAT. So, I like RCAT.' (holder-positive, weak direct call). Calls: MOD, ARKQ, AVAV, RCAT BUY (Brian); AMBA not in this video. Note: 'Iran' = IREN, 'Arcat' = Redcat RCAT, 'Nukes' = NUKZ ETF.
